newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with lower Japanese prices, brokers said on Tuesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe ended lower across the board, pressured by private investors' profit-taking in reaction to Monday's rises.
They said news that the United States had launched a missile attack against Iraq today had little impact on the market.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due to an absence of fresh incentives," a local broker said.
"But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some late local selling interest in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," he said.
At 0945 GMT, October RSS3 fell 1.25 cents to 130.00 U.S. cents a kg.
November RSS1 fell 1.75 cents to 191.00 Singapore cents (US$1.36) a kg.
January/March TSR20 fell one cent to 185.50 Singapore cents (US$1.32) a kg.
